summary: LG Display Co., Ltd., a Korean foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on October 2, 2026 serving as prior notice that its 2026 third-quarter earnings will be disclosed on October 22, 2026, covering the period July 1 through September 30, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is referenced; the filing merely schedules an earnings release to be posted on the company's investor relations website, and notes the date may change. The filing is a routine earnings-timing notice with no special-situations mechanics or risk-arb angle to monitor.
